item.title: Shaheed Bhagat Singh: The Legacy Quiz – MyGov (Shaheed Bhagat Singh commemoration)
item.description: Prize: Top 50 winners get ₹2,000 each; 30 winners get a visit to the Shaheed-E-Azam museum; all participants get an e-certificate. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Log in on quiz.mygov.in and answer 10 multiple-choice questions in 300 seconds (one attempt); winners are drawn at random among those who answer all 10 correctly, and your MyGov profile must be accurate to qualify. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 31 October 2026

item.title: Shaheed Bhagat Singh's Words: One Quote, One Commitment essay competition – MyGov (Shaheed Bhagat Singh commemoration)
item.description: Prize: Top 50 participants get ₹5,000 each; top 30 also get a visit to the Shaheed-E-Azam museum in Punjab. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Pick one Bhagat Singh quote, write a short essay on its meaning and a personal commitment, and submit it on the MyGov task page. Indian citizens only; free MyGov login (mobile/email OTP) required; no entry fee. Closes 23:45 IST on 31 October 2026.

item.title: STAEDTLER International Creative Challenge 2026: Around the World – STAEDTLER
item.description: Prize: Four prizes of a EUR 1,500 travel voucher + STAEDTLER product package worth EUR 500, plus a product-package prize. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Upload a clear top-down photo of your own hand-drawn artwork on the theme "Around the World" on the STAEDTLER page by 23:59 UTC on 31 October 2026 (free, AI images not accepted, jury and fan vote). Only for creatives aged 18+ permanently resident in the listed countries, including South Africa (organizer is German)

item.title: UFO Newsletter Subscriber Competition: R10,000 furniture voucher – United Furniture Outlets (UFO)
item.description: Prize: R10,000 UFO furniture voucher. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Subscribe to the UFO email newsletter via the form on the competition page (name, email, mobile, nearest store). No purchase. South African residents 18+ living in a province with a UFO store. Closes 31 October 2026. Entering subscribes you to UFO marketing emails; no UFO win in the last three months

item.title: 국민생각함 특이민원 예방·해소 아이디어 공모전 2차 국민심사 투표 — 디지털 온누리상품권 5천원 20명 – 국민권익위원회 국민생각함
item.description: Prize: 5천원 상당 디지털 온누리상품권 (20명 추첨). Deadline: October 31, 2026. 국민생각함(epeople.go.kr)에 무료 회원 로그인 후 예선 통과작 20건 중 우수작에 투표하고 '참여하기' 클릭 → 개인정보 활용 동의 후 참여 완료 (구매 불필요). 한국 거주자 대상 설문·투표이며 한국 휴대폰 본인확인/회원가입이 필요할 수 있음. 당첨자는 추첨

item.title: Bargain Books: Win A Court of Splintered Harmony by Sarah J. Maas – Bargain Books
item.description: Prize: A copy of A Court of Splintered Harmony by Sarah J. Maas (prize value not stated). Deadline: November 1, 2026. Free online entry form on bargainbooks.co.za/competitions (name, surname, mobile, email). South African residents only; one entry per person per competition; newsletter opt-in is optional. Closes 1 November 2026
